slots.role: One image of the starting state, already in motion
slots.visualRecipe: Close crop of one cut-out subject at about 90% of frame height, on textured ground. No title.
slots.motionRecipe: A single part of the subject rocks from frame 20. Pull-back at about 1.5 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Measured in the source: voice from frame 2, one short silence at 1.78-2.14 s. Keep that gap and let the pull-back finish in it.

copySlot.purpose: First half of the opening sentence, spoken only

slots.role: Chapter 1, in which each line is made by what it means
slots.visualRecipe: Subject left at 40% of the frame. Headline upper right at 40% of width. Secondary line under it, small object right, caption strip low.
slots.motionRecipe: Label at 1.7 s. Letters one by one from the first word, then a line written, a shape drawn, a typed strip. Each is timed to the words.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice leads. Inferred: small material sounds could follow the actions; not established from the data.

copySlot.purpose: A plain claim about the starting state, split into three phrases

slots.role: Chapter 2: what came earlier, shown as objects with years
slots.visualRecipe: Slide to an empty panel of a different texture. Objects fill it left to right, each with a date stamp and caption. A grid of many small units in the lower half.
slots.motionRecipe: Move of 10 frames, eased. Empty at least 5 frames. Objects drop in on spoken dates. Grid units stagger in row by row, then change state together.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice leads. One whoosh is plausible on the move; inferred.

copySlot.purpose: Date and short caption per object

slots.role: Chapter 3: the breakthrough as a sum of parts
slots.visualRecipe: Heading first, upper right, in a period face. Subject portrait left at 50% height. Three small objects joined by plus signs, then a flash to the result on the same place.
slots.motionRecipe: Heading written in, portrait pops at 17.9 s. Each part arrives on its word, 0.6 s apart. Fade or flash at 23.5 s to the result, with spatter marks.

copySlot.purpose: Name, place, three parts, a line about the result

slots.role: Chapter 4: growth that resists an attempt to halt it
slots.visualRecipe: A full panel map or similar field. Tag upper left. Number on a torn strip lower left, 40% of width. Small repeating objects stacked beside it. Attempted-halt mark centre right.
slots.motionRecipe: Slide, 15 frames. Points pop from one origin outward. Counter climbs across about 1.2 s on the spoken figure. Loose pieces fly between points, then one physical mark lands and leaves.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice leads. Counter could take a rising tick; inferred.

copySlot.purpose: When, how much, what it beat

slots.visualRecipe: A full-frame document arrives, then the principal subject right, a measuring dial left, small moving parts in the corners.
slots.motionRecipe: Throw instead of a slide, in 0.5 s, overshoots by about 10%, then settles. Gauge needle follows a true value and shows the figure within about 0.5 s of it being spoken. Small parts rotate throughout.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice leads. Impact on landing is plausible; inferred.

slots.visualRecipe: Warm rough ground. One big subject in the centre, a second one left, a figure right, accent-coloured headline at the top, placed last.
slots.motionRecipe: Slide, 10 frames. Object enters stepping on twos and threes. Dates slam; headline slams last at 40.3 s.

copySlot.purpose: Short headline, two dates, two captions

slots.visualRecipe: White panel. Each generation of the subject is smaller than the last. A row of many small items along the bottom.
slots.motionRecipe: Slide, 10 frames. First device, then its note, then each smaller device on its spoken name, about 1 s apart. Row staggers across the bottom.

slots.role: Chapter 8: the present, with type made by the process
slots.visualRecipe: Lively labels: new colours appear only here. Big word left at 30% of width, new subject at the centre, three result objects on the right.
slots.motionRecipe: Slide, 10 frames. Subject falls from above at 46 s. Word builds with a rising scan line at 46.8 s. Results appear on their words, 0.8 s apart. Hold.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice leads. List ends; leave a beat.

slots.role: Pull back to show the entire sheet
slots.visualRecipe: All eight panels in a 4 by 2 grid with a faint title. Viewer sees everything they have watched, in order.
slots.motionRecipe: 4.1 s symmetric eased pull-back (power2.inOut, from rest, fastest about 2 s in) with a tilt of about 5 degrees that straightens slowly. No new objects arrive.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice holds the closing sentence. A swell may suit it; inferred.

slots.role: Title darkens to full contrast, then one small stamp
slots.visualRecipe: Same frame, title in full contrast at 30% of width, small line under, one small tagline at the bottom, stamp upper right.
slots.motionRecipe: Almost still. Title snaps from faint to solid at 55.9 s under a 12-frame whole-frame flicker. Subtitle types on. Stamp slams at 58.0 s. Hold to the end.
slots.soundRecipe: Measured: silence in the last 0.9 s of the source.

copySlot.purpose: Title that doubles as the last spoken word, one line, end stamp

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat grid (source tempo has confidence 0.11). Voice sets all timing: start objects on their words, and start each slide in the pause after a sentence, so that the first word of the next chapter arrives as the move settles. Chapters 4 to 10 s. Internal events every 0.3 to 1.5 s.

style: One large sheet with panels in a 4 by 2 grid, die-cut engraved figures with white rims on aged textured grounds, red stamps, torn strips and lettering that changes period by period.

keep: A single sheet with one camera and a closing reveal
Blank panel before each chapter fills
One pattern break at the midpoint
Closing title doubling as the last word
mustChange: Period lettering, chosen for the new subject
